The Cofferdam lockup: the v5 mark beside or above the "Cofferdam" wordmark (Geist 700, -0.03em tracking, outlined so it needs no font).

## When to use
- `horizontal` (default) — site nav, headers, footers, email signatures, documents.
- `stacked` — title cards, store art, square or centred spaces.
Use the mark alone (`CofferdamMark`) when the name is already on screen.

## The consumer provides
`layout`, `height` (clear space included; default 32 horizontal / 96 stacked) and `tone`:
- `ink` (default) — mark and wordmark in one colour (`currentColor` / `color`): `fg` on any ground, white on Cerulean or photos.
- `mono` — greyscale mark (`mark-mono-*`) with an `fg` wordmark. Light or dark grounds.
- `tones` — colour mark (`mark-*`) with an `fg` wordmark on dark and navy grounds. In light it falls back to the greyscale mark automatically (the pale tones vanish on white).

## Rules
- Geometry, in wordmark cap heights (C): horizontal mark 1.4C, gap 0.5C; stacked mark 3.2C, gap 0.6C; clear space 0.5C on every side (built into the box).
- Minimum: horizontal 34px tall (mark 20px, cap 14px); stacked 84px tall (mark 46px). Below that, use the mark alone.
- Never retype the wordmark in live text, change the gap, swap the order or add the statement inside the lockup.
- Files: `assets/logos/lockups/cofferdam-lockup-{horizontal,stacked}-{on-dark,on-light,white,black}.svg`, generated by `scripts/make-logos.py`.
